title: Light styles
description: Animated brightness patterns for lights, keyed by style number (a light entity's style key). The patterns are Quake's, from Quake 2's g_spawn.c (GPLv2 or later, id Software). Presentation only: the sim doesn't read them.

step_time.description: Seconds each letter of a pattern lasts. Quake steps patterns 10 times a second.

styles.description: Styles 0 to 31. ericw-tools assigns 32 and up to switchable lights, which stay at normal brightness until switching exists.

name.description: Shown in TrenchBroom's style choices; must match the FGD.

pattern.description: Brightness per step, looping: 'a' is dark, 'm' is normal, 'z' is a little over double.
